facts.status_note: Sources disagree: one trail guide calls the site of an old lookout, while others describe a standing tower.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Canada Lookouts and the 1959 clipping place the tower on Batchawana Mountain, while Ontario High Points places it on the higher peak it calls Griffin Lake Peak. The High Points coordinates are close to the record's coordinates, and it says Ministry of Natural Resources maps name the lower summit Batchawana Mountain. The story reports the disagreement and does not choose.

notes_for_editor: No build date appears in any source read, so the story gives none. The only dated event is the July 1959 fire from a reprinted clipping on Canada Lookouts. Standing status is unsettled: SummitPost and the still-standing list say it stands; Superior Hiking calls the site an old lookout; the High Points posting is from 2009. A human may want a recent photo or report. The MNRF GeoHub tower layer (cached at data/raw/ontario_lio/fire_towers.geojson) gives a point at 47.07458, -84.38259 under the official name 'Batchawana Mountain' with no height, date or status; it could not be cited because the GeoHub page is JavaScript-only. The record's other name 'Batchawana Mountain' matches that official name. The firelookout.ca record has no photos and no height or date. Searches used: two, within budget. Forest History Ontario and provincial archives were not checked. No photos added.
